# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.5 Worker 3: Unit Abilities, Eurasian Town Rights, Dual-File Regencies & Shinto Factions (0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla/GUI/DLC overrides). Generated by gen_v135_institutions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# File prefix 00_oe_ sorts strictly before vanilla 00_republican_election.txt (ASCII 'o' < 'r')
# so Venice's Council of Ten captures Venetian republican regencies with 0 vanilla file overrides.

oe_reg2_venetian_dieci_regency = {
	allow = {
		has_or_had_tag = VEN
		government_type = government_type:republic
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_republican_tradition = 0.08
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.08
		global_burghers_estate_power = 0.10
		global_defensive = 0.08
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_reg2_active_type value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_cabinet_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
				}
			}
			ordered_cabinet_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = adm
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				}
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = root.culture
					religion = root.religion
					estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
					age = 52
					female = no
					adm = 65
					dip = 62
					mil = 48
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_inst.1 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_reg2_active_type }
			remove_variable = oe_reg2_active_type
		}
		add_republican_tradition = republican_tradition_weak_bonus
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_inst_reg2_dieci_legacy_mod
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}
